syllabus_topics: Introduction to technological processes of bulk plastic deformation, sheet plastic deformation, and cutting.
Selection of mechanical processing technologies for metallic materials based on attributes related to materials, product type, manufacturing series, and cost factor.
Phenomenological aspects of mechanical behavior of metallic materials.
Influence of temperature and strain rate.
Friction, wear, and lubrication, tribological characterization tests.
Uniform energy method, elementary slice method, and slip line method.
Technological processes of bulk plastic deformation: Forging.
Technological processes of sheet plastic deformation: Stamping.
Technological processes of sheet cutting: Blanking.

assessment_methods.method: Group work analysing the manufacturing sequence of a metallic component

assessment_rules: For the special period, assessment is based on an exam (60%) and group work analyzing the manufacturing sequence of a metallic component (40%).
